finish_summary:
bulk_discount_percent(50) returns 5 instead of expected 10 per spec.
parse_coupon is case-sensitive, rejecting "save5" despite spec allowing it.
Cart.remove_item leaves items with quantity 0 in the dict; spec says item should be removed entirely when quantity reaches 0.
Cart.total calculation yields 79.0 instead of 80.0: shipping fee or rounding off by one; likely shipping_fee is applied to subtotal after coupon but implementation uses before coupon or misrounds.
